ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Reg Add BitLocker
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious addition to BitLocker related registry keys via the reg.exe utility

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*REG.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*ADD.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\FVE.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/v.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/f.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*EnableBDEWithNoTPM.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*UseAdvancedStartup.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*UseTPM.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*UseTPMKey.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*UseTPMKeyPIN.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*RecoveryKeyMessageSource.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*UseTPMPIN.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*RecoveryKeyMessage.*")))
